name: Teraurge
source: You are dozing off when suddenly a magical portal opens up and swallows you into another dimension. Turns out this was the result of a failed teleportation attempt and now you find yourself stranded in a world where all sorts of alien creatures exist. With little more than the clothes on your back, some currency and advice from the Witch, the culprit of your current situation, you set off to find a way back home...
translation: 你打瞌睡时，一座魔法传送门突然打开，把你吞进另一个次元。原来，这是一次失败传送的结果，如今你被困在一个充满各种外星生物的世界。身上只有衣服、一些钱，以及造成这一切的女巫提供的建议，你踏上寻找回家方法的旅程……
